# `manuscript/`

* `paper.tex`: the paper, set with the Springer Nature template (`sn-jnl.cls`, unmodified) in the APA style of Swarm
  Intelligence (`sn-apacite.bst`): the main text with every figure of the method and of the results, the
  declarations, the references and the appendices. `paper.pdf` is its compiled version.
* `sections/`: the related work and the appendices, input by `paper.tex`.
* `numbers.tex` and `tables/*.tex`: generated by `analysis/make_numbers.py` from the result files; never edit by hand.
  A number that is not yet computed prints in red in the PDF.
* `references.bib`: bibliography. Every reference carries its DOI, checked against Crossref or DataCite, except four
  that have none (two PMLR papers, an ACL Anthology paper and the e-puck paper), which carry the link of their
  official record.
* `fig_overview.tex`: the overview of the method (Fig. 2), a standalone TikZ drawing built to `figures/fig_overview.pdf`.
* `checks/`: placement of the floats (`check_floats.py`) and margins of the text (`check_margins.py`) in the compiled PDF.
* `figures/`: symbolic link to the repository `figures/`.
* `verify_propositions.py`: symbolic (SymPy) and numerical verification of the three propositions, of the
  closed-form gradients of appendix A, of the invariance of the traceless part of M2, and, on synthetic milling
  groups, of the envelope property used by the attribution and of what the average over a recording does to a
  vortex that drifts or reverses; all checks pass.
* `lean/`: Lean 4 proofs of the three propositions with Mathlib, without any unproved step (Proposition 1 for one
  agent and for a recording, the invariances of Proposition 2 under rotations and mirror images, the radial integral of
  Proposition 3); `lake build`, then `lake env lean CheckAxioms.lean` lists the axioms each theorem uses (see
  `lean/README.md`).

Build:

```bash
python analysis/make_numbers.py
cd manuscript && latexmk -pdf paper.tex
```
